operations.summary: Changes an image as instructed, keeping what the instruction doesn't mention.

operations.summary: Paints the masked area from the prompt, or fills it plausibly without one; everything outside the mask stays exactly as it is.

x-mes-ui.help: 0 = Realistic (no new content). Higher adds more invented detail.

models.notes: Returns the prompt image.generate would run with prompt_enhance on, rewritten with target_model's own profile and the job's seed, without generating; this backbone rewrites them for klein-4b, klein-4b-base, mage-flow, mage-flow-turbo, qwen-image-flash, z-image, z-image-turbo, and the engine picks it when target_model is one of them. Run the target with that text (and the size, when one comes back: a layout is only right at its size), the same model named, and prompt_enhance off. FLUX 3 Klein's own upsampler can't be previewed.
